Although it's far away, I'm always grateful for your help.

You're a very good teacher.

Even with an appointment, you might have to wait for over an hour, so I recommend going with plenty of time to spare.

For simple health checkups (blood tests) and regular checkups, it's relatively affordable and convenient, and all the doctors are trustworthy, so I recommend it.

It's a relatively old-fashioned hospital and doesn't have the latest equipment.

My cat's condition wasn't diagnosed here, but it was found at a medical center. Therefore, if you suspect a disease and the cause can't be identified here, I recommend going to a medical center.

This clinic has only top-notch doctors, attracting patients from neighboring prefectures.

I was looking for a vet in Shinagawa Ward, the neighboring town, when a woman who happened to be a patient here recommended it.

Since then, I've been using this clinic as my cat's regular vet, so when I moved last year, I settled in a place where I could continue going here.

Meguro Ward is generally quite unfriendly towards cats, so I think this is the only excellent vet here.

The head vet, the female vet in charge, and the male vet are all incredibly caring and attentive.

The staff are all very kind, so I'm so glad I found this clinic.

They were very considerate and helpful.
The receptionists, nurses, and doctors were all very kind.
The waiting room is simple and well-worn, and the doors and other details of the examination room give off a sense of history, but you can somehow feel the trust of the people who come here.
While some clinics now separate pets from their owners and examine them in a back room,
we enter the examination room together, receive explanations while checking the area being treated, and see the procedure performed right in front of you.
This reduces the dog's anxiety and gives the owner peace of mind.
I wish I had found out about this sooner.
I was grateful that they also take back any unused medication.
As the reviews said,
the prices are reasonable and clear, and I was able to receive treatment with peace of mind.
I would like to continue visiting this clinic, but the only downside is that it's in a residential area and the nearest train station is by bus, making it difficult to access.

There's no other animal hospital that treats dogs and cats with this much love and care.

They're not motivated by money; they genuinely want to save pets.

There will be a wait. However, they will also provide a detailed explanation.

If there is an emergency, priority will be given, so this is for those who don't mind waiting.

Recently, they have switched to an appointment system, but

If they determine that treatment is necessary, they will see you even on holidays.

It's extremely considerate that pet owners can enter the examination room to see what treatment will be administered. The quality of the doctors, the fair treatment fees—everything about this animal hospital is trustworthy.
They are very kind and reassuring.

My beloved dog is a valued patient here.

This is a trustworthy animal hospital where they always provide thorough examinations, accurate treatment, and clear explanations.
